ideas.pitch: A predictive model for campus-wide facility maintenance issues and student support service bottlenecks using Poisson GAM and rolling backtests.
ideas.title: Campus Incident AI Forecasting Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact technical pattern of the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon winner by using rigorous statistical modeling rather than a generic wrapper.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered risk detection platform combining graph intelligence and LightGBM to audit student organization funding requests and detect anomalies.
ideas.title: Student Grant AML and Risk Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by combining graph databases and machine learning models, matching the winning architecture of the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace with USDC escrow payments on Base that automatically disburses hackathon team bounties upon verified GitHub PR merges.
ideas.title: Decentralized Hackathon Bounty Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the Synthesis Hackathon winning project by providing fully autonomous financial execution via escrow on Base.

ideas.pitch: A localized nutrition and wellness platform that analyzes dining hall menus to deliver personalized meal recommendations and micronutrient tracking for students.
ideas.title: Campus Dining AI Nutritionist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages hyper-local utility tailored directly to student life, echoing the practical, prize-winning health focus of the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite image monitoring pipeline to detect heat loss and roof-mounted solar panel efficiency across university campus buildings.
ideas.title: GreenQuad Energy Monitoring Satellite Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the technical computer vision and GIS integration that won the Xcelerate Hackathon runner-up spot.
